we provide a systematic approach to calculate HOMFLY colored invariants for two-bridge knots and, in particular, for the first time, we give explicit results for the colored HOMLY polynomials for the representation {2, 1}.

the colored HOMLFY polynomials for knots can be obtained from the corresponding Wess-Zumiano-Witten model by using crossing matrices and multiplicities of the corresponding primaries.
